title: A progress bar while haiku clusters the skills
head: 4b750cd4d81c2fe666093b672ddc87e5019021c7

clause.text: while it runs, under the button: the spinner and `Listing <org>’s repositories…`, then `Scanned N of M repositories` and the progress bar, as the organization's own scan shows them

scenes.caption: The organization scanned again, as its own scan shows it: “Scanned 3 of 5 repositories” and the repositories’ bar

clause.text: then `Clustering N skills with haiku…` and a **progress bar** of the skills, in the repositories' bar's place, from 0

scenes.caption: Then haiku: “Clustering 7 skills with haiku…”, and a bar of the skills from 0 in the repositories’ bar’s place

clause.text: as the model's answer streams, `Clustered K of N skills with haiku…`, the bar moving on with each skill it puts in a cluster

scenes.caption: The answer so far, “[3, 5”: 3 is whole, 5 may still grow; “Clustered 1 of 7 skills with haiku…”
The answer: 7 skills in 2 clusters, the bar gone, the button enabled again
All 7 placed: the bar full, and the same spinner turning since clustering began
Scan JetBrains, then Cluster skills: “Listing JetBrains’s repositories…”, the button disabled

clause.text: The model: **haiku**, through Claude Code on the server: `claude -p --model haiku --output-format stream-json --verbose --include-partial-messages`, no session kept

clauses.notShown: the server’s claude -p has nothing on screen; tests/organization-clusters.test.ts checks its arguments
claude’s raw output has nothing on screen; tests/organization-clusters.test.ts reads it streamed
the server’s environment has nothing on screen; tests/organization-clusters.test.ts runs a fake claude

clause.text: How far the model is: each skill number in a `"skills"` list of the answer so far, once it is *whole* (a comma, a space or the `]` after it: `1` may be the start of `12`), counts the skills of its line, once

scenes.caption: The answer so far, “[3, 5”: 3 is whole, 5 may still grow; “Clustered 1 of 7 skills with haiku…”

clause.text: a number not in the list, or named again, does not

scenes.caption: Then “3, 5, 3, 9, 1, 2] … [7,”: build named again and 9, not in the list, do not count; 5 of 7

clause.text: `GET /api/clusters/progress?name=<org | org/ | GitHub URL>` → the same, as NDJSON, one JSON a line, as it goes: `{ progress: { scanned, of } }` as the organization is scanned again
